---
name: Feature request
about: A sign-in method, plugin option or adapter that auth lacks
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What your app needs to do**

Describe the user-facing flow, not the implementation. "Users sign in with a code sent to WhatsApp" is more useful than "add a WhatsApp plugin".

**What you tried**

The plugins and options you use today, and where they stopped. A plugin of your own can add operations, hooks, columns and tables; if you wrote one, say what it could not do.

**Who else ships it**

Products or libraries that offer the same thing. Features are ranked by how many real products ship them.
